title.zh: 除法与余数 · 分不完的那一点
title.en: Division & Remainders · What Is Left Over

desc.zh: 分糖果分到最后总剩几颗：先动手一份一份发，再到数轴上一格一格跳——余数为什么必须比除数小，跳着跳着就明白了；然后是验算恒等式和星期几的循环，最后两道自测题收口。
desc.en: Sharing sweets until a few are left over: deal them out one share at a time, then hop along the number line — and see for yourself why the remainder must stay smaller than the divisor; then the check identity, weekday cycles, and a two-question self-test.
